body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1165 merge `72029cd16057199be441058c69dd783604541100`, head `c68342b0f6989a8e59187706134c5e1de7eca690`. Original #912 stays open with its exhausted budget and scientific-source waits; do not reserve or expand its original contract.

Two bounded evidence defects:

1. The README, reproduction status and manifest/review limits call registry digest `63e1878b1a484787aafa029e3f2a8cb063d9d720b38e9d17884a999d28cd10f8` a generated unretained importer-cache object whose provenance cannot be reconciled. Independently read the full pinned upstream GitHub tree at geoBoundaries commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`: its `geoBoundaries-VUT-ADM1_simplified.geojson` LFS object has exactly this SHA and size **133,712**. Retrieved all bytes via GitHub CLI and independently hashed them to the same value. The separate full product has **1,094,439** bytes, SHA `69f44b96d0690310c67a4a430488fb7a02d028bdec8bbc755436cdfb90962c8d`. Both complete payloads contain the exact same six native shapeIDs. Thus distinct full/simplified byte products reconcile the two hashes; an unretained private cache does not prevent establishing the simplified product identity. This does not prove current legal boundaries or justify replacing the screen's full-product geometry.
2. The producer overwrites existing `reproduction.json`; validator runs it twice and overwrites three existing `checks/*.json` receipts. No fresh-output refusal exists. Executed actual validator and its actual two child producers in a managed exact-merge slot with disclosed child/write/read publication boundaries redirecting only attempted bytes into own fresh scratch. Both full reports match retained SHA `66c8a66ee5ed6e5c06468e5d51b4ffc9aa25c533577e57f691402ec99b990a3a`; all three fresh controls match. Boundaries recorded existing original destinations/prior hashes, and original packet remained unchanged. Passing identity/name booleans does not establish preservation. The controls' unchanged numerical result is not alleged wrong.

Success criteria for one additive geography PR:
- Preserve #454/#1165/#912 original packets, codes, sources, outputs, IDs/dates and shared helper bytes; work only under the disjoint owned prefix below. Do not reopen closed #454 or alter #912’s exhausted contract/claim.
- Correct source interpretation in additive dated findings: authenticate complete full and simplified distributions/metadata, actual native IDs, selector transform and immutable origin; distinguish whole-file identity from legal source suitability. Retain prior full-product diagnostics and explain exactly which geometry each screen consumes. Do not silently substitute simplified input into historical output or claim survey/effective-date approval.
- Add documented fully offline, fully pinned fresh-output reproduction for all six original subjects. Reject existing output/control sentinels, traversal and symlink escape before writes; publish exclusively. Bind all actually executed project code and all consumed immutable inputs, including all **36 world-index parts** scanned for uniqueness (203,277,878 bytes), not just the containing part. Preserve full subjects/parents/classifications and all 24 historic metrics. Two complete fresh runs must reproduce original report values and retain meaningful input/code/identity and publication controls with independent exact-head implementation/source/applicable geometry review.
- Complete unique declared objects, consumed world parts and actual three shared modules plus new simplified source and 8 MiB reserve total 223797142 bytes at audit admission, below 256 MiB; largest world part 12,932,167 bytes. Recalculate actual new capsule/control/output bytes, keep 32 MiB object/256 MiB phase/512 descriptor caps, and omit no original. Entire executed scientific helpers match baseline bytes. Existing six raw Atlas/full-source pairs are valid and all 24 screen calculations independently recompute exactly.
- No current Orders, municipality exclusions, island completeness, DLA/DUAP institutional authentication, geography approval, ownership, repair, import, deployment or publisher acceptance is established. Keep all six classifications insufficient-evidence. Those scientific source waits are independent of this provenance/preservation correction.

Complete duplicate/overlap search: 882 open/closed issues (100 x 8 + 82), seven open PRs; no Vanuatu digest/guard correction or later repair covers these findings. Other ready guard issues have different packets/scopes. Dependency #454 is closed. Initially blocked pending fresh current-main shared readiness/ownership review; urgent does not bypass that review.
